general.title: General
general.smallModelHint: Controls which model receives lightweight/free requests when routing.
general.apiKeysHint: One key per line (or comma-separated). Leave empty to disable request authentication.
general.legacyAuthNote: Legacy fallback remains enabled for env {{env}} or config.apiKey when auth.apiKeys is empty.
general.anthropicApiKeyHint: Optional. Used for exact Claude /v1/messages/count_tokens calls; without it, the server falls back to local token estimation.
general.anthropicApiKeyEnvNote: Runtime fallback remains available through env {{env}}. Leaving this field empty does not override a server-side environment variable.

compactThresholds.itemHint: Sent as compact_threshold for this model.
compactThresholds.itemInvalid: Threshold must be a positive integer.

aliases.defaultBehaviorHint: Default behavior: {{behavior}} original model IDs. Each alias can override this setting.

mappings.title: Model mappings
mappings.description: Rewrite exact client model names before provider alias parsing.

responsesApi.title: Responses API
responsesApi.description: Configure Responses API transport, web tools, and context management.
responsesApi.useResponsesApiWebSocketHint: When enabled, models advertising ws:/responses use Copilot's WebSocket transport; HTTP remains available for /responses-only models.
responsesApi.useResponsesApiWebSearchHint: When enabled, /v1/responses keeps web_search tools and forwards them upstream.
responsesApi.messageApiWebSearchModelHint: Claude /v1/messages requests that only use Anthropic web_search are switched to this model. A plain Copilot model uses the Copilot Responses web search path; provider/model uses provider Messages passthrough. Leave empty to disable.
responsesApi.messageApiWebSearchSuggestionsHint: Suggestions are candidates only, not validation. Custom values are allowed.
responsesApi.useResponsesApiContextManagementHint: Default: enabled. When enabled, the proxy automatically adds context_management compaction instructions for long Responses API tasks.
responsesApi.contextManagementInactiveHint: This legacy list is saved but does not take effect while context management is disabled.
responsesApi.compactThresholdsInactiveHint: Compact threshold overrides are saved but do not take effect while context management is disabled.
responsesApi.responsesApiContextManagementModelsDepre: Deprecated legacy allowlist. Prefer the global Responses API context management switch.

devMode.title: Developer Mode
devMode.description: Enable in-app request replay and outbound capture for debugging.
devMode.enableHint: Required to access the Replay page. Backend enforces this flag.
devMode.captureHint: Persists full outbound body + redacted headers to admin.sqlite. Cleaned up with request history (35 days).

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.modelRefreshIntervalHint: Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.
advanced.sessionAffinityRetentionHint: Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup of persisted L2 session affinity rows.
advanced.allowOriginalModelNamesHint: Default behavior when aliases do not override original model IDs.
advanced.forceAgentHint: Affects Copilot Premium request consumption counting: when off, every agent conversation request counts as 1 (same as the VS Code extension); when on, multiple requests in the same session count only once per model.
advanced.compactUseSmallModelLabel: Route compact requests to small model
advanced.compactUseSmallModelHint: When enabled, compact requests use the configured smallModel; otherwise they use the requested model.
advanced.messageStartInputTokensFallbackHint: When enabled, estimates message_start input tokens when upstream usage is unavailable.
advanced.useMessagesApiHint: When enabled, Claude-family models may use Copilot's native /v1/messages endpoint.
advanced.useResponsesApiWebSocketHint: When enabled, models advertising ws:/responses use Copilot's WebSocket transport; HTTP remains available for /responses-only models.
advanced.useResponsesApiWebSearchHint: When enabled, /v1/responses keeps web_search tools and forwards them upstream.
advanced.responsesApiContextManagementModelsHint: List of model IDs that should receive Responses API context_management compaction instructions.
advanced.providersDescription: Configure upstream providers. Each provider key becomes a route prefix (/:provider/v1/messages).
advanced.providersQuickAddHint: Quick add fills safe defaults only. The row stays editable and existing provider keys are never overwritten.
advanced.providersTypeHint: Select how requests are translated before they are sent upstream.
advanced.providersAuthTypeHint: Controls whether the API key is forwarded as x-api-key, Authorization: Bearer, or an OAuth2-style provider token.
advanced.providersOAuth2Hint: OAuth2 is mainly for built-in or special providers such as Codex. For regular custom providers, prefer x-api-key or Authorization unless the backend integration explicitly supports OAuth2.
advanced.providersAdjustInputTokensHint: Subtract cache read/write tokens from upstream usage.input_tokens.
advanced.providersModelTypeHint: Override routing for this model when one provider serves multiple API protocols.
advanced.providersContextCacheHint: Marks this model as using provider-side context cache accounting.
advanced.providersSupportPdfHint: Allows PDF content when this provider model supports it.
advanced.providersToolContentSupportTypeHint: Choose the tool content shapes this model accepts.
